name: Washer/dryer column
description: Tall built-in white cabinet with a front-loading washing machine on the floor and a tumble dryer stacked on a shelf above it (each 60 x 85, standard sizes), behind two tall doors, plus a storage compartment with its own door above 176. Double-click a door to open the doors.

doors.description: pair (two tall doors + a top door) | stacked (lower + upper full-width door)

hinge.description: stacked doors: hinge side seen from the front

lowOpen.description: stacked doors: degrees the lower door opens (less when something is in the way)
